description: Na₉Sm(Ge₂Se₆)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2 space group. There are six inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six Se atoms to form NaSe₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one SmSe₆ octahedra, corners with three NaSe₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one SmSe₆ octahedra, and edges with nine NaSe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 3-9°. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 3.03-3.26 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six Se atoms to form NaSe₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one SmSe₆ octahedra, corners with three NaSe₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one SmSe₆ octahedra, and edges with nine NaSe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 3-13°. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 3.01-3.29 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six Se atoms to form NaSe₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one SmSe₆ octahedra, corners with three NaSe₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one SmSe₆ octahedra, and edges with nine NaSe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 1-4°. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.95-3.18 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to six Se atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing NaSe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 1-9°. There are two shorter (3.07 Å) and four longer (3.10 Å) Na-Se bond lengths. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded to six Se atoms to form NaSe₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaSe₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one SmSe₆ octahedra, and edges with eight NaSe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-13°. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 3.06-3.14 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded to six Se atoms to form NaSe₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaSe₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent SmSe₆ octahedra, and edges with seven NaSe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 3-7°. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 3.04-3.11 Å. Sm is bonded to six Se atoms to form SmSe₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaSe₆ octahedra and edges with nine NaSe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-7°. There are a spread of Sm-Se bond distances ranging from 2.95-2.98 Å. There are two inequivalent Ge sites. In the first Ge site, Ge is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three Se atoms. There are a spread of Ge-Se bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.46 Å. In the second Ge site, Ge is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three Se atoms. There is one shorter (2.36 Å) and two longer (2.41 Å) Ge-Se bond lengths. There are six inequivalent Se sites. In the first Se site, Se is bonded to four Na, one Sm, and one Ge atom to form SeNa₄SmGe octahedra that share corners with seven SeNa₄SmGe octahedra and edges with ten SeNa₅Ge octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 4-87°. In the second Se site, Se is bonded to five Na and one Ge atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SeNa₅Ge octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-86°. In the third Se site, Se is bonded to five Na and one Ge atom to form SeNa₅Ge octahedra that share corners with seven SeNa₅Ge octahedra and edges with ten SeNa₄SmGe octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-85°. In the fourth Se site, Se is bonded to four Na, one Sm, and one Ge atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SeNa₄SmGe octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 3-87°. In the fifth Se site, Se is bonded to five Na and one Ge atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SeNa₅Ge octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-87°. In the sixth Se site, Se is bonded to four Na, one Sm, and one Ge atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SeNa₄SmGe octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-87°.
